Messages.Author: trozycki@maroon.tc.umn.edu
Messages.Body:
The local Jyhad group, when voting, gives each Methuselah one vote
automatically.  For example, if I call a vote, I get one vote from the
political action card plus one "automatic" vote.  I can't find anything
in either the original or corrected rules that allows the automatic vote,
but I also can't find anything that directly contradicts it.  Can anyone
give a compelling argument either for or against the One Methuselah, One
Vote policy? 

  I would be especially interested in knowing the original intent of the
rules.  As I read them, no Methuselah should automatically get a vote, but
I'm way outnumbered in that belief.  I would sure like to see this 
addressed in the next FAQ or corrected rules.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
<trozycki@maroon.tc.umn.edu> wrote:
>  I would be especially interested in knowing the original intent of the
>rules.  As I read them, no Methuselah should automatically get a vote...

Your reading is correct.  The ways of getting votes are listed in
section 17.1, and nowhere does it say they get votes for free.  If
people don't want to be left out of votes, tell them to stock up on
titled vampires and/or political cards.
